scoring_justification: Absolute values are compared to paper-reported references within generous tolerances (0.5 eV for energies, 0.5 Å for distances); monotonic trends with Zn content (work function decreases, d-band center more negative, ΔG_H* increases, C-C distance decreases) provide the primary structural check. A full recompute is not possible because the verifier cannot run DFT.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for the four alloy systems (Cu, Cu3Zn, CuZn, Cu5Zn8) extracted from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 3(b,d) and Figure 5(b,c) and corresponding text; identical to the values written by the reference solve.sh.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription of the DFT-reported numbers: work function (eV), d-band center (eV), ΔG_H* (eV), C–C distance (Å).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values reported in the source paper and serve as the target for a correct reproduction. No synthetic alteration.

outputs.description: Contains the computed work function, d-band center, hydrogen adsorption free energy, and co-adsorbed C-C distance for pure Cu, Cu3Zn, CuZn, and Cu5Zn8 surfaces. The hidden checker compares these values against reference values obtained from a published source with tolerance, and additionally verifies that the relationships among the four alloy compositions satisfy appropriate structural consistency checks.

output_contract.notes: The checker will perform a reference match against hidden gold values (±0.5 eV for energies, ±0.5 Å for distance) and will additionally audit the internal consistency of the results across the four alloy compositions. The agent must use a consistent pseudopotential library and exchange-correlation functional; systematic toolchain shifts are absorbed by the tolerance.

steps.description: Combined scoring: 0.7 weight on absolute value match within tolerance, 0.3 weight on correct monotonic ordering of each property across the four alloys.
